entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Tribhuvan Mishra - Advocate for appellant.
 Shri Mohan Sausarkar - Government Advocate for responde
Shri Ashish Vishwakarma - Advocate for objector.

Heard on IA No. 11592/2024, which is the third application under Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of appellant-Akhtar Khan @ Akhtar Baba for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Appellant has been convicted under Section 506 of IPC read with Section 3(2)(va) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 2 years with fine of Rs. 500/- and under Section Section 376(1) read with Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life with fine of Rs.500/-, with default stipulations.
As per the case of the prosecution, the appellant, who is a married person aged about 40 years, has proposed the prosecutrix asking her that he was in love with her and asked her to develop relationship with him.
The prosecutrix thereafter denied the proposal and asked the appellant that he is father figure, but still the appellant did not control himself and was continuously following the prosecutrix.
Appellant also threatened her, if she would not accept his proposal, he would kill her father.

On the date of 2 CRA-8917-2023 incident, when prosecutrix was coming back from the market, the appellant asked the prosecutrix to come with him and he would drop her to the house and he carried her in a jungle and has committed rape with her.
She objected the appellant and shouted, but nobody came to protect her.
Although, immediately she did not apprise this incident to her parents but after some delay, she informed them and then police report was made.

Learned counsel for the appellant during the course of argument submitted that the prosecutrix has stated before the Court, if wife of appellant had not come to the spot, she would not have lodged the report to the police.

It is also submitted that the age of the prosecutrix though as per school record is Akhtar Khan @ Akhtar Baba Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24262429/
1 below 18 years, but there was no source of information as to on what basis, the date of birth of the prosecutrix was recorded in the school register.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, he prays that looking to aforesaid facts of the case, application may be considered and remaining jail sentence of appellant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.

Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that looking to the period of incarceration and conduct of the present appellant and the fact that the findings which have been recorded by the Court below are based upon the material produced during the course of the trial, the bail application at this stage cannot be considered.
Learned counsel for the objector has submitted that the school register is material evidence for determining the age of the prosecutrix and as per the said date of birth, she was minor and same has been considered by the Court below.
3 CRA-8917-2023
We have considered the arguments putforth by the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the age of prosecutrix and the age of appellant, prima facie, it is a case of commission of rape with a minor girl and looking to the period of custody, application for suspension of sentence is rejected.
Also heard on I.A. No. 23733/2024, which is an application for urgent hearing of this appeal.
On due consideration, the application is disposed of directing the Registry to list appeal in due course.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) (VISHAL   JUDGE JUD  vkt Akhtar Khan @ Akhtar Baba Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24262429/
